cues: Brace your trunk before lifting the bar from the rack.
Keep your feet planted as you bend your hips and knees.
Let your knees follow the direction of your toes.
Stand up by extending your hips and knees together.
commonMistakes: Letting the heels rise during the descent.
Allowing the back to round under the bar.
Letting the knees collapse inward.

cues: Plant your feet and keep your upper back supported on the bench.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar under control toward your chest.
Press the bar upward until your arms extend.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Using a grip so wide that it restricts the movement.
Lifting the hips off the bench during the press.

cues: Hinge at your hips with your knees slightly bent.
Keep your back steady while you hold the hinged position.
Draw the bar toward your upper waist.
Lower the bar with control until your arms extend.
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back while bent over.
Jerking the torso upward to move the bar.
Cutting the lowering phase short.

cues: Grip the bar with your palms facing away from you.
Start from a controlled hang with your arms extended.
Pull your body upward until your chin clears the bar.
Lower yourself with control back to the starting position.
commonMistakes: Swinging the legs to gain momentum.
Using a grip so wide that it limits the range of motion.
Dropping quickly instead of controlling the descent.

cues: Set your feet under the bar and grip it around shoulder width.
Brace your trunk and keep the bar close to your legs.
Push through the floor as your hips and knees extend.
Stand tall without leaning back at the top.
Lower the bar under control by bending your hips and knees.
commonMistakes: Letting the bar drift away from the legs.
Rounding the back while lifting.
Yanking the bar from the floor instead of building tension first.

cues: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side.
Step forward and lower under control, keeping your torso upright.
Keep the front knee tracking in the same direction as your foot.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then switch sides.
commonMistakes: Letting the front heel lift as you lower.
Allowing the front knee to collapse inward.
Rushing the descent and losing balance.

cues: Stand with feet about shoulder width and hold the bar at your upper chest.
Brace your trunk before pressing.
Press the bar overhead until your arms extend.
Lower the bar under control to your collarbone.
commonMistakes: Leaning back and flaring the ribs to move the bar.
Letting the bar drift far forward during the press.
Dropping the bar quickly on the way down.

cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet supported.
Keep your lower back in contact with the floor.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abdominals.
Lower slowly until your shoulders return to the floor.
commonMistakes: Pulling on the head or neck with the hands.
Using momentum instead of a controlled curl.
Lifting the lower back and turning the crunch into a sit-up.

cues: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and brace your trunk.
Bend your hips and knees together as you lower under control.
Keep your knees pointed in the same direction as your toes.
Stand by extending your hips and knees.
commonMistakes: Letting the heels lift from the floor.
Allowing the knees to collapse inward.
Dropping quickly into the bottom position.

cues: Lie on the bench with a dumbbell at each side of your chest.
Keep your feet planted and upper back supported.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms extend, keeping them controlled.
Lower to the sides of your chest with a steady motion.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the weights at the bottom of the press.
Letting the dumbbells drift far out of line with your elbows.
Dropping the weights instead of controlling the lowering phase.

cues: Sit against a supported bench with a dumbbell at each shoulder.
Keep your elbows below your wrists at the start.
Brace your trunk and press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the weights under control to shoulder level.
commonMistakes: Overarching the lower back to finish the press.
Starting with the weights far below shoulder level.
Dropping the dumbbells quickly on the way down.

cues: Support one hand and the same-side knee on a bench.
Keep your back steady as you hinge forward.
Pull the dumbbell toward the side of your chest.
Lower until your arm extends, then repeat on the other side.
commonMistakes: Rotating the torso to swing the dumbbell upward.
Rounding the back while holding the hinged position.
Shortening the controlled lowering portion of the row.

cues: Stand with a dumbbell at each side and feet about shoulder width apart.
Bend your hips and knees as you lower with your back steady.
Keep your knees tracking in the direction of your toes.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
commonMistakes: Letting the heels lift as you descend.
Allowing the knees to collapse inward.
Rounding the back while holding the weights.

cues: Rest the bar across the front of your shoulders with your elbows lifted.
Brace your trunk and keep your chest tall.
Lower between your legs while your knees follow your toes.
Drive through your feet and extend your hips and knees to stand.
commonMistakes: Letting the elbows drop and the bar roll forward.
Allowing the knees to fall inward.
Shifting onto the toes and lifting the heels.

cues: Stand with the bar close to your thighs and knees softly bent.
Brace your trunk and send your hips back to hinge.
Keep the bar close as it travels down your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back as the bar lowers.
Bending the knees so much that the hinge becomes a squat.
Letting the bar drift away from the legs.

cues: Hold a dumbbell at each side with a small bend in your knees.
Keep your back steady as you push your hips back.
Lower the weights along your legs until your hamstrings stretch.
Extend your hips to return to standing.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back to reach lower.
Locking the knees rigidly during the hinge.
Turning the movement into a deep knee bend.

cues: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet planted about shoulder width.
Brace gently and press through your heels to lift your hips.
Stop when your torso and thighs form a straight line.
Lower your hips slowly back to the floor.
commonMistakes: Arching the lower back to lift the hips higher.
Pushing mainly through the toes as the heels rise.
Letting the knees drift inward.

cues: Stand tall with the bar settled across your upper back.
Step forward and lower until your rear knee approaches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee aligned with your foot.
Push through the lead foot and step through to the next repetition.
commonMistakes: Taking steps so narrow that balance is lost.
Letting the front knee collapse inward.
Rushing between steps without regaining a stable stance.

cues: Set the bar across your upper back and stand with a stable stance.
Step forward and lower under control with your torso upright.
Let the front knee follow the direction of your foot.
Push through the front foot to return, then change legs.
commonMistakes: Leaning the torso far forward during the descent.
Allowing the front knee to fall inward.
Rising by pushing mostly from the rear foot.

cues: Stand upright with a dumbbell at each side.
Step one leg back and lower your rear knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over your foot.
Push through the front foot to stand, then switch legs.
commonMistakes: Taking a step so short that balance or depth is limited.
Letting the front knee collapse inward.
Twisting the torso as you step back.

cues: Place your hands slightly wider than shoulder width on a stable raised surface.
Step back until your body forms a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the surface by bending your elbows.
Press through your hands until your arms extend.
commonMistakes: Letting the hips sag or pike during the repetition.
Allowing the elbows to flare far out to the sides.
Stopping well short of the surface on each descent.

cues: Lie on an incline bench with the bar positioned above your upper chest.
Grip the bar so your forearms are nearly vertical at the bottom.
Lower the bar under control to your upper chest.
Press upward until your arms extend without bouncing the bar.
commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest.
Using a grip so wide that it limits the range of motion.
Lifting the shoulders or hips from the bench to finish a rep.

cues: Start with one dumbbell beside your shoulder and wrist stacked over elbow.
Brace your trunk and keep your torso steady.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm extends.
Lower it under control to your shoulder, then switch arms.
commonMistakes: Leaning or rotating the torso to help the weight rise.
Letting the wrist fold back under the dumbbell.
Dropping the weight quickly on the way down.

cues: Sit against a supported bench with the bar at shoulder height.
Grip the bar overhand and brace your trunk.
Press the bar overhead until your arms extend.
Lower the bar slowly back to your shoulders.
commonMistakes: Overarching the lower back to move the bar.
Letting the bar drift well forward of the shoulders.
Dropping the bar quickly during the lowering phase.

cues: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with knees softly bent.
Keep your back steady and let your arms hang beneath your shoulders.
Pull both dumbbells toward your sides with elbows close to your body.
Lower the weights slowly to the starting hang.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back while hinged forward.
Swinging the torso to lift the dumbbells.
Shrugging the shoulders instead of rowing the elbows back.

cues: Hold the dumbbells with palms facing each other and hinge at your hips.
Keep your back steady as your arms hang below your shoulders.
Row the weights toward your sides while drawing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the dumbbells under control.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back during the hinge.
Twisting or rocking the torso to move the weights.
Cutting the controlled lowering phase short.

cues: Take a shoulder-width or slightly narrower underhand grip on the bar.
Begin from a controlled hang with arms extended.
Pull until your chin reaches bar height, keeping your elbows near your sides.
Lower slowly until your arms extend again.
commonMistakes: Swinging the legs to create momentum.
Reaching the chin forward instead of lifting the body.
Dropping quickly before reaching a controlled hang.

cues: Secure the V-handle over a pull-up bar before gripping it.
Hang with a firm grip and keep your chest lifted.
Pull your chest toward the handle while keeping the torso controlled.
Lower slowly back to a full hang.
commonMistakes: Using the V-handle without securing it on the bar.
Swinging the body to start the pull.
Stopping short instead of lowering with control.

cues: Lie on a flat bench with your legs extended beyond its end.
Hold the bench or place your hands beneath your hips for support.
Raise your legs until they point upward, keeping them controlled.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch away from the bench.
commonMistakes: Swinging the legs to build momentum.
Arching the lower back as the legs lower.
Bending the knees substantially during the lift.

cues: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and thighs raised over your hips.
Keep your arms still as you curl your pelvis and hips off the floor.
Bring your knees toward your chest without swinging your legs.
Lower your hips slowly to the starting position.
commonMistakes: Swinging the legs to lift the hips.
Pushing down forcefully with the hands to create momentum.
Dropping the hips instead of lowering them under control.
